zohoIntegrationGuide.title: How to integrate Zoho Inventory with your SimHo account
zohoIntegrationGuide.intro: Follow these steps to connect Zoho Inventory, authorize access, and configure field mapping so records can sync into SimHo.
zohoIntegrationGuide.mappingNote: Note — Field mapping facilitates data sync from Zoho Inventory to your SimHo account. No records can be synced if field mapping is not saved.

connect.title: Click Connect
connect.body: From Settings → Integrations, open Zoho Inventory and click Connect to start the integration.
connect.imageAlt: Zoho Inventory integration card with Connect button

authenticate.title: Authenticate with your Zoho Inventory account
authenticate.body: Sign in with the Zoho account that has access to the Zoho Inventory organization you want to connect.

allow.title: Allow platform access and click Accept
allow.body: Review the requested permissions, confirm access for the platform, and click Accept to continue.
allow.imageAlt: Zoho permission consent screen with Accept button

success.title: Integration successful — click Finish Setup
success.body: When the integration completes, click Finish Setup to continue to the field mapping screen.
success.imageAlt: Integration completed dialog with Finish integration button

mapping.title: Configure field mapping and save
mapping.body: Select SimHo fields and the corresponding Zoho fields. Turn Pull Historical Records off if you do not want to sync all existing records from Zoho Inventory for the respective module. Then click Save Mapping.
mapping.imageAlt: Field mapping screen with SimHo and Zoho field pairs

finish.title: Finish
finish.body: You have successfully integrated Zoho Inventory with your SimHo account. If you pulled historical data, check the respective module for synced records. Otherwise, only new records created after mapping is saved will appear.

profile.title: Personal profile flow
profile.description: This section explains how the personal profile screen loads, edits, and submits user details.

flow.load: Load the signed-in user profile from the API and render the profile form when data is ready.

flow.token: Read token or pinDetailsKey from URL search params to determine whether to fetch live pin details or load stored payload.
flow.payload: For numeric tokens, fetch public pin details from the API; for non-numeric tokens, load client-side stored quotation scope payload.
flow.preview: Render the quotation pin preview modal with plot and drawing data once the payload is available.
